player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a game of Indian Poker.
- 52-card deck; you see only the opponent's card.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) each round, {max_rounds} round(s) total.
- Valid moves: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X is a positive integer <= your chip count.)
- Highest hidden card wins the pot at showdown.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Naya ka tsela e lekalekane, e.g. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', kana '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: Ga o ka ke wa [check] - go na le papadi e lo tshwanetseng lwa betšha mo go yone.
invalid_move.amount_min: Selekanyo sa go betšha / go oketsa se tshwanetse go nna ≥ 1.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Ga go na sepe se o ka leletsang mogala; wena o ka nna wa [check] dira jalo.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Dirisa [bet X] go bula; ga gona bethe e o tshwanetseng wa e oketsa.
invalid_move.insufficient: Ga go na ditšhipisi tse di lekaneng gore o ka dira jalo.

message.folded: Motshameki {player_id} o ne a latlhela bolo.
message.showdown_tie: Showdown tie: both {card}. Pot split – each receives {split}.

outcome.draw: Ditshitshisi tse di lekanang morago ga metshameko yotlhe.
